title: Revisiting Downsampling in Semantic Segmentation: Fighting Aliasing with Dynamic Gaussian and Gabor Frequency Filters
mechanism: Dynamic Gaussian low-pass along edge normals only, then a learnable Gabor directional band-pass that removes residual aliasing peaks concentrated along a few dominant directions; phase-error energy metric.
adaptation: EL aliasing is directionally sparse (fingers one axis, busbars the other), matching its assumption. Use the Gabor selector before stride-2 layers; use phase-error energy as a diagnostic of finger aliasing in the house encoder.
min_experiment: Arm: house + LFS (and DGK) at strides; baseline house; kill if crack IoU < +0.012 and E1 relF1@2 < +0.02; only after Seg-Aliasing shows a signal.
evidence: R: consistent gains and sharper boundaries across segmentation datasets (abstract; numbers not read).
